prompt: A rectangular data center room measures 12 meters by 8 meters. Server racks take up 40% of the floor space. If each server rack requires a minimum clearance zone equal to 25% of its own footprint, calculate the remaining usable floor space in square meters.
evaluation_criteria:
Area Calculation: 0-5 (Evaluates total area and rack space computation)
Clearance Logic: 0-5 (Evaluates correct application of clearance factor)
response_text:
**Step‑by‑step calculation**

| Item | Calculation | Result |
|------|-------------|--------|
| Total floor area of the room | \(12 \text{ m} \times 8 \text{ m}\) | \(96 \text{ m}^2\) |
| Area occupied by the server racks | \(40\% \times 96 \text{ m}^2\) | \(0.40 \times 96 = 38.4 \text{ m}^2\) |
| Clearance zone required (25 % of rack footprint) | \(25\% \times 38.4 \text{ m}^2\) | \(0.25 \times 38.4 = 9.6 \text{ m}^2\) |
| Total area taken up (racks + clearance) | \(38.4 \text{ m}^2 + 9.6 \text{ m}^2\) | \(48.0 \text{ m}^2\) |
| Remaining usable floor space | \(96 \text{ m}^2 - 48.0 \text{ m}^2\) | **48 m²** |

**Answer:** The remaining usable floor space in the data‑center room is **48 square meters**.
